title: Allow untracked serving variants in public table orders
rootCause: Menu availability deliberately treats serving variants without ingredient definitions as NOT_TRACKED and orderable, but inventory reservation throws when the same variant has no ingredients. The public table order reaches authoritative hydration successfully, then fails while reserving inventory.
